One model • one synthetic task • separate studies, not pooled

Pair scores combine separately sampled sender and receiver policies; they are not observed pair play.
Lines in panel 2: 95% bootstrap intervals. *Only 9 restricted and 7 authorized receiver calls; descriptive points only.
